verdict.rationale: Productboard has a core feedback repository that automatically detects insights linkable to feature ideas, notes can be linked to features to quantify demand, and features can be pushed into delivery/tracked—directly supporting turning feedback into actionable tasks/initiatives. This is reinforced by API/MCP capabilities to create feedback, link it to features/initiatives, and push prioritized features into delivery. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the feedback-to-feature workflow UI and any case-study evidence of PM usage in practice.
